title: QUIC RFC 9000 Client 0-RTT Handshake Value Supersession Policy Work Item
summary: Close the bounded S7P4P1 client handshake-value policy by resolving prohibited remembered parameters from the server's new handshake values or defaults instead of prior remembered values.
planned_changes:
- Extend QuicZeroRttTransportParameterPolicy with a client handshake-value resolver for prohibited remembered parameters.
- Clone server handshake values for connection-ID, stateless-reset-token, preferred-address, and max_ack_delay fields.
- Fall back to default max_ack_delay and absent/null values when the server omits a prohibited remembered parameter.
- Add focused requirement-home tests for handshake value supersession and default fallback.
- Retarget RFC9000-S7-4-1-P4-S2-R01 trace links to focused proof.
verification_plan: Run a Release build, run the focused S7P4P1 requirement-home filter, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, validate SpecTrace JSON, run the full Release test suite without rebuilding, and check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
out_of_scope: REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S7P4P1-0010 through REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-0356 updated-value-in-0-RTT sender and receiver enforcement.
completion_notes: Completed as a focused internal client handshake-value supersession policy and requirement-home proof for RFC9000-S7-4-1-P4-S2-R01.
